# Mexico City Grand Prix Preview

Verstappen hunts his fourth consecutive world title as McLaren's resurgent pace threatens to disrupt Red Bull's dominance in the season's decisive stretch. Norris and Leclerc battle for position in the midfield melee, with tire degradation and Mexico City's thin air reshaping strategy calculations at the 2,250-meter altitude. A victory here swings momentum decisively in the constructors' battle, with McLaren closing within striking distance of Red Bull's lead as the championship enters its final four rounds.
